offering_description.value: Golden Entertainment operates Nevada casinos and resorts that offer gaming, lodging, dining and entertainment to locals and visitors. It also runs neighborhood taverns that serve food and drinks and offer video gaming.

primary_services.value: casino gaming; hotel lodging; restaurant and bar service; live entertainment and attractions; tavern video gaming

customer_segment.value: B2C: Local gamblers, tourists, hotel guests and tavern patrons; B2B: Corporate meeting organizers and group travel planners

end_markets.value: casino gaming; leisure travel and hospitality; food and beverage; live entertainment; meetings and events

revenue_model.value: other: Casino and tavern gaming wagers after player payouts; service fees: Hotel stays, meals, drinks, event bookings and admission to shows and attractions

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Operates equipped casinos, hotels and taverns for local patrons and visitors; service provider: Provides lodging, dining, entertainment and event services to guests and groups

geography_served.value: US regional: Nevada, including the Las Vegas area, Laughlin and Pahrump

specialization.value: related lines: Casino resorts, local casinos and neighborhood gaming taverns

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated casinos, hotels, restaurants and taverns; online: Resort websites for room reservations and attraction tickets; direct sales: Property sales teams for meetings, events and group stays

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Casino and tavern gaming require Nevada Gaming Commission licensing and Nevada Gaming Control Board oversight.

notes: The exact current property portfolio and ownership structure are uncertain.
